problem.title: Count Downward Paths with Sum K
problem.problemStatement: Given a binary tree whose nodes contain integer values and an integer K, determine the number of downward paths whose node values sum to exactly K. A path may start and end at any nodes but must always move from parent to child.
problem.input: • The first line contains an integer N. • The second line contains the node values. • The next N lines describe the binary tree. • The last line contains K.
problem.output: • Print the number of qualifying paths.
